purpose: Outcome-independent Ogasawara island-area lock for the held-out raw weighted-network capacity test, with GIFT retained only as a cross-source geography audit.

primary_area_source.title: 2026 Area Survey by Prefecture, Municipality, Lake and Island (2026-04-01)
primary_area_source.table: Island area, Tokyo, PDF page 86 / printed page 83
primary_area_source.reason: One authoritative national area table contains all four held-out Ogasawara islands. It replaces the invalid GIFT substring match of Ototojima to an unrelated To-jima before any biological result is admitted.

gsi_map_sheet_gate.purpose: Reject homonymous/substring island entities outside the Chichijima island group; this is a geography-only QA gate.

primary_lock_rule: Use the four GSI 2026 island areas exactly as frozen above. These values are independent of network outcomes and are verified against the official PDF before analysis.
gift_audit_rule: GIFT is not the primary Ogasawara area source. A candidate must satisfy the frozen alias rule and be within 25% of the authoritative GSI area; Ototojima candidates must also lie inside the frozen GSI Anijima-sheet bounding box. A failed GIFT audit cannot be substituted into the primary area values.
claim_boundary: This file repairs geography only. It does not alter the four source-native Ogasawara weighted networks, the PR #187 reference mapping, the predeclared ABM directions, permutation test, or decision thresholds.
